plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A lean planning harness: a marker-driven edit gate keeps the repo read-only until a Mermaid-first Markdown plan is approved, then implementation runs subagents-first (SDD). Plans carry their own build state across sessions — split, handoff, resume, review, ship, merge.

plugins.name: sdlc-mini
plugins.description: Turbo SDLC helpers: a release-notes generator and a tidy commit helper. Manifest and env-config setup have moved to the devflow plugin; init-turbo-manifest and init-turbo-env-config remain as deprecated redirects.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Session harvesting and plugin lifecycle tools: harvest a project's sessions into reusable Claude Code artifacts, learn from a plugin's sessions to auto-improve and republish it, track usage, and run it all unattended on a daily schedule — with every install isolated to its own Claude config dir.
